name_input: Kappa Coffee Pvt Ltd. (Cohoma Coffee Company)
export_evidence: No export record found. ImportKey page https://importkey.com/countries/india/kappa-coffee-pvt-ltd returned only a paywalled shell: 'Shipments available for KAPPA COFFEE PVT LTD, refreshed daily' — zero rows rendered, no date, destination, HS code or B/L number visible. Volza (https://www.volza.com/p/coffee/export/exporters/india/kappa-coffee/) and Eximpedia (https://www.eximpedia.app/companies/kappa-coffee-private-limited) both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, so no rows could be read there either. Bing search for '"Kappa Coffee Private Limited" export OR turnover OR "bill of lading"' returned 124,000 results but the top 8 were all about the Kappa sportswear brand and kappa folklore — no trade-data page for this entity. Source counter: 3 trade-data sources attempted, 0 shipment rows actually seen.
domestic_evidence: Own website https://www.cohomacoffee.com/ shows an active D2C retail operation with priced SKUs and B2B segments, e.g. 'Original Custom Roast Rated 4.36 out of 5 ₹ 775 – ₹ 875' and menu sections 'Hotel & Hospitality / Cafes & Restaurants / Offices & Institutions / White Labelling / Offline Retail Partners'. This is a product catalogue and marketing claim only — no GST turnover figure, no GeM/CPPP tender, no contract and no annual-report split was found. Google search for GST/turnover/GeM returned HTTP 429; TheCompanyCheck and ZaubaCorp returned HTTP 403, so no financial filing could be read. Source counter: 1 company site read (catalogue), 3 registry/financial sources blocked, 0 turnover or contract records seen.
note: Legal entity KAPPA COFFEE PRIVATE LIMITED is claimed but could not be verified against MCA — ZaubaCorp and TheCompanyCheck both blocked (HTTP 403), so CIN/PAN/incorporation status are null, not confirmed. Declared HS 090121 (roasted coffee, not decaffeinated) is consistent with the product range on the company site (roasted whole bean, cold brew, coffee bags, capsules), so no HS correction is proposed; note that green-bean trading would fall under 0901.11 instead. No export shipment evidence found in any accessible source — this is 'not found', not 'does not exist': the only trade-data page that loaded was a paywall with zero rows, and the two free-view alternatives refused access. Domestic activity is real as a live retail/B2B business per its own storefront, but turnover band and any institutional supply contracts remain unverified. Per Rule 5: no customs or B/L record and no GST/contract record was located, so neither export nor domestic supply is confirmed by documentary evidence; the site's catalogue and B2B menu are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. No rejection grounds apply (entity not shown liquidated or struck off).
